text:
kai: Quick update from the bring-up run — ran a 10k-query A/B (rwd-v4p1 baseline vs rwd-v4q-lite quantized candidate) on staging for 6 hours.

devon: raw highlights: cost per token down ~34%, avg latency p50 +5%, p99 +12% (tail impact shows in longcontext slices), throughput slightly higher under batching.

marta: slice-wise—any regressions that look scary? which user slices did the ROUGE/hallucination spikes show up on?

kai: longform-summaries and multi-step instructions. ROUGE-L down ~1.8 pts on long-summaries slice; hallucination rate (detected by our anchor checks) +0.9% absolute. Short Q/A and chat slices look fine.

devon: dropping snippet of the quick slice table:

```
slice,longform,shortqa,dialog
baseline_ROUGE,42.1,65.3,58.4
candidate_ROUGE,40.3,65.1,58.6
baseline_hall,2.3,1.1,0.9
candidate_hall,3.2,1.0,0.8
p50_ms_baseline,110,85,95
p50_ms_candidate,115,86,97
p99_ms_baseline,420,190,230
p99_ms_candidate,470,205,265
```

marta: thanks. For rollout gating — do we have an auto-fallback policy param set for hallucination delta > 0.7% or ROUGE drop > 1.5? current canary is at 5% traffic.

anil: current automated gate is: if any safety or fidelity metric exceeds threshold delta for 30m window and persists for 3 windows -> immediate fallback of the candidate to 0% and alert. thresholds are: hallucination_delta=0.5%, rouge_delta=1.0 by default (we tuned these last quarter).

sylvia: given the longform drop is 1.8 (above 1.0) I'd prefer to tighten the gate for this canary: raise sensitivity for longform slice (we can scope fine-grained metrics). propose per-slice override: longform_rouge_delta=1.2 and hallucination_delta=0.4 with a 15m confirmation window.

kai: +1 to per-slice overrides. We should keep canary running but reduce traffic to 2% and enable stricter autosensors on the longform slice.

devon: pushed a tentative rollout policy to the canary config. snippet (yaml):

```
canary:
  traffic: 0.02
  monitor:
    window_minutes: 15
    confirm_windows: 2
    metrics:
      - name: longform.rouge_l
        delta_threshold: 1.2
      - name: longform.hallucination_rate
        delta_threshold: 0.4
      - name: global.p99_latency
        delta_threshold: 15.0  # ms
    auto_fallback: true
```

ops-bot: automation rule deployed -> watching metrics stream for canary 1729970123, will trigger fallback on confirmed breach and post /incident if fallback occurs. :satellite:

marta: also recommend running a targeted synthetic burn for 50k longform prompts in shadow to collect more signal before we revert or promote.

kai: agreed. devon, can you queue that shadow job and keep the canary at 2% until we have the shadow run results? sylvia, can you prepare a minimal rollback playbook for on-call if auto-fallback flips the traffic? include quick comms template.

devon: queued shadow 50k job (ETA 90m). I'll attach the run id here when ready.

sylvia: will draft rollback playbook now and post to #incidents. quick comms template: "Auto-fallback triggered for rwd-v4q-lite canary at {ts}. Traffic reverted to baseline. Investigating slice-level regressions: longform."

anil: one more thing — we should log the model binary hash and quant config in the canary metadata so promotion can't happen without re-run. added metadata flag `promotion_blocking_tags: [longform-smoketest-failed]` to the job.

kai: perfect. TL;DR: keep canary live at 2%, stricter per-slice thresholds, run 50k shadow longform job, ops-bot will fallback automatically on confirmed breaches, if it triggers we follow sylvia's comms. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
